svg.title: Relvo Agent Workflow: Skills-first multi-agent collaboration workflow
svg.desc: Neutral single-column banner: goal and authority into a coordinator, one grouped choice of direct tools, single agent or optional multi-agent execution, questions and checkpoints during execution, evidence fan-in for correlated review, one bounded repair, delivery or a blocked stop, an optional development lifecycle shown as a separate annotation, and a shared skills and contracts layer.
svg.text: Acceptance, dependencies, write scope. Chooses the smallest
Dependency-ready disjoint scopes. Not always faster
Applies during execution. Persisted ≠ observed ≠ applied.
Unsupported resume → blocked. History ≠ live durability.
Coordinator correlation and exact target readback
Frozen candidate → PR + fresh review → human merge, separately
Portable across tools. Distinct from provider adapters, which are
Bundle groups records for offline checks, not a runtime supervisor.
Reference workflow, not a runtime. Provider probes: NOT RUN.
Offline checks do not verify external state.
